In the 100 yards we had first two places through Gordon Lowers and Basil Walden, and the latter also won the 220 yards with Alan Picton in second place.

Hamlin, Picton and Barnes were regular training companions until Bob Barnes moved to Cambridge; then the 'pack' broke up. Is it too much to hope that these three will make a come-back and realise the form they so often promised to produce?.
Dave King came through well followed by Pat Duncan. Without Farley, Baker, Cameron or Picton it was left to John Keown to bring the team in fourth.
In the team event there were several strong teams out but defending champions Belgrave were so strong that despite losing Duquemin, Keown and Picton we were still able to win by 11 points.

Sexton won his heat in 24.1; Tebbutt won his heat in 24.6; Picton, Marshall and Rae were each second in their heats. Sexton beat Marshall in the second round in 23.6; Picton won his second round in 23.9.
Lawton, Hall, Picton and Dunsford filled 1st, 2nd, 5th and 7th places at Downley over 5Km., and Graham Seatter won the Luton 10Km. with Ray Middleton 12th.
